verdict.rationale: Mollie Connect is documented for platforms and marketplaces. Split payments move funds from the marketplace's holding balance to each connected seller's balance, and application fees let the platform take a commission. Merchant onboarding is mentioned only as a Connect page name and as an onboarding-status webhook event, and no evidence shows payouts from seller balances to the sellers' own bank accounts. missing for 10: detailed seller-onboarding API/flow documentation, explicit per-seller payout-to-bank documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller

citations.quote: Mollie Connect lets software platforms and marketplaces offer payment and money management capabilities to their merchants under their own brand.

Mollie holds the incoming funds in an escrow-like account (your marketplace's holding balance) before distributing specified amounts to each connected seller's balance, while letting you retain a portion of the funds as a commission
Application Fees allow your platform to collect a fee on every payment you process on behalf of a connected account.
New event types to offer a broader context for your business processes (e.g. payment creation, invoice creation, onboarding status changes etc).
